title: lotus gebelia subsp. libanoticus
intro: Lotus gebelia subsp. libanoticus, commonly known as the Australian lotus, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Nelumbonaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lotus gebelia subsp. libanoticus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-diabetic properties, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
